subject: Pilot top-up: ops-insurance vs performance-linked discount — proposal
messages:
From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@innovatemed.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot top-up and ops-insurance question

Hi Vivek,

Quick question as we're approaching the end of our 30-day pilot: engineering expects another 2–3 weeks of smoke testing and we'd like to avoid losing momentum. There are a couple of options we discussed internally and I wanted your input + ballpark pricing: 

1) Short time-box top-up (2 weeks) with the same throughput SLA as the pilot.
2) A performance-linked extension: we convert to a short commitment but include a rebate/discount tied to meeting latency/accuracy KPIs.
3) Ops-insurance add-on: an operational guard that provides a service credit if availability drops below X during the extended window.

Can you send the typical pricing ranges and any paperwork we should expect (amendment vs PO)? Procurement is cc'd. We don't need final legal now — just enough to show leadership.

Thanks,
Alyssa Turner
Head of Platform Integrations
InnovateMed

Attachments: none
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@innovatemed.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot top-up and ops-insurance question

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the clear breakdown. Good news: we have two pragmatic paths that customers commonly pick depending on procurement appetite. I attached a short options sheet. High level: 

Option A — Timebox top-up
- 2 weeks at the pilot daily throughput: $6,500 total (one-off charge)
- Same SLA as pilot; amendment to statement of work (SOW)

Option B — Performance-linked short commit
- 30-day conversion at a reduced committed rate (20% below list)
- If KPIs not met, customer receives a rebate ladder (10–20%) applied against the first renewal invoice
- Requires a short amendment + KPI attachment

Ops-insurance add-on (optional): $1,200 for the extension window — provides a 10% service credit if availability < 99.5% during the period. We can waive the charge for the first month with manager approval.

Next steps: if you want the two-week stopgap, we can draft an amendment and route to procurement for a PO. If you'd prefer the performance-linked structure, we'll need the KPI targets (latency percentile, token accuracy proxy) and procurement sign-off for the commit.

I've attached: pilot-amo-options.pdf (summary). Happy to hop on a 20-min call if that helps.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Sr. Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachments: pilot-amo-options.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-23T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: suggested concession for InnovateMed

Vivek — quick note before you send anything final to Alyssa.

Recommended concession framework to move this fast: 
- For Option A (2-week top-up): reduce to $5,850 (10% off) and waive ops-insurance for that top-up window.
- For Option B (performance-linked 30-day): keep the 20% discounted commit but add a two-level rebate (missed KPIs -> 10% rebate; missed by large margin -> 20%).
- If procurement is pushing on paperwork timing, propose a single PO for the amendment and treat the ops-insurance as a credit line item so we can reverse if they convert.

If you want, I can loop legal to draft a minimal amendment and route to procurement. Given InnovateMed's timeline, I think the 2-week reduced top-up + creditable ops-insurance is lowest friction.

Kimberly Park
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@innovatemed.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, procurement@innovatemed.com
Date: 2026-05-24T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot top-up and ops-insurance question — recommended hybrid

Hi Alyssa — following up with a recommended, low-friction path tailored to your timeline: 

Recommended hybrid (what we usually see close quickly):
- Immediate: 2-week top-up at $5,850 (one-off). We will waive the ops-insurance charge for that top-up window.
- Contingent: If InnovateMed converts to a 30-day commit within 10 business days after the top-up, we will apply a performance ladder: 0–2 KPI misses -> no rebate; 3–5 misses -> 10% credit; >5 misses -> 20% credit applied to the first renewal invoice. KPI definitions will be confined to P95 latency and a simple accuracy proxy we agree on.

Paperwork: attached SOW_draft_InnovateMed.docx and amendment-topup.docx. Practical routing: procurement can issue a PO referencing the amendment id DEAL-9482-AMD1 and we will countersign. If procurement prefers, we can also generate a DocuSign link for faster signature (attached).

Next steps: 
1) Can procurement confirm PO timeline?
2) Alyssa — confirm the KPI targets we should use (suggest P95 < 450ms, accuracy proxy > 88% for the smoke tests).
3) I will have legal prepare a minimal amendment to attach to the PO.

If this works, I'll kick off legal and send the DocuSign link for the amendment. Happy to jump on a 15-min call to iron out KPI wording.

Thanks — Vivek
Sr. Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW_draft_InnovateMed.docx, amendment-topup.docx
From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@innovatemed.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@innovatemed.com
Date: 2026-05-26T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot top-up and ops-insurance question — recommended hybrid

Thanks Vivek — that hybrid is exactly the pragmatic approach we discussed with the team. Procurement, can you confirm if you can issue a PO for DEAL-9482-AMD1 by Friday? We'll accept the 2-week top-up at $5,850 and the KPI ladder you proposed.

For KPIs, let's start with your suggested targets (P95 < 450ms, accuracy proxy > 88%). If engineering flags anything during smoke tests we'll loop you immediately.

I'll route to procurement now — please send the DocuSign link when legal is ready and we'll sign.

Best,
Alyssa Turner
Head of Platform Integrations
InnovateMed

Attachments: InnovateMed_PO_stub.pdf (will follow with formal PO)
